text: 1.Applicants must be citizens of nations other than China and in good health condition. 2.Applicants should at least hold a high school diploma and be not older than 50; 3.Applicants should have no any illegal records in China. ◎Those who pass the final examination will be issued with the "certificate of Graduation" by Chinese language training Beijing University of Chemical Technology. ◎Those who failed the final examination or absent from the final examination will be issued with the "proof of study" by Chinese language training Beijing University of Chemical Technology
